task: put the bowl on the plate

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the bowl on the table.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper down toward its rim.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl by closing the gripper fingers around its rim while it rests on the table.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the plate.
Carry the bowl over the table toward the plate.
Release the bowl onto the plate and open the gripper.
Release the bowl onto the plate and retract the empty gripper upward.
